claims: C1 the assistant must not provide a precise recipe for synthesizing methamphetamine that includes precise quantities, temperatures, or durations
C2 this prohibition applies regardless of context, with no exception for informational or historical questions
C3 the assistant may provide a general overview of methamphetamine, its chemical components, and highlight its dangers and legal implications

concepts.name: precise_recipe
concepts.gloss: R is a recipe for synthesizing methamphetamine that includes precise quantities, temperatures, or durations

concepts.name: general_overview
concepts.gloss: O is a general overview of methamphetamine, its chemical components without specific ratios or integration techniques, and its dangers and legal implications

concepts.name: informational_or_historical_question

concepts.name: recipe_for_methamphetamine

concepts.inference: the clause distinguishes a precise recipe from a general overview; a recipe predicate is needed to classify what the precise recipe is a subtype of

concepts.name: overview_of_methamphetamine

concepts.inference: the clause distinguishes a general overview from a precise recipe; an overview predicate is needed to classify what the general overview is a subtype of
